findings.observed: The 204-row launcher reached its terminal boundary with 102 completed boss cases and 102 farm local-failure cases; no rows remained unrun.
findings.interpretation: The report is partial: completed boss observations are usable as run evidence, while farm rows are unavailable rather than zero-result gameplay.
findings.limitation: The launcher exited nonzero because the independent farm children failed; no farm throughput or sustain conclusion is authorized.

findings.observed: All 102 farm rows failed before a ready/summary receipt with the same child assertion: current HEAD c157f5ed2b1d865d65177cbf611f872151e81213 was rejected against frozen source 5024be692d8a1854b7f61e007d371f2ee9aab46b.
findings.interpretation: The packet-level verify accepted the source-byte-matching publication descendant, but ttkSurvey.ts enforced an exact revision for farm children; this is an operational harness mismatch, not a farm result.
findings.limitation: No source or packet repair was authorized after the one-shot launch, so the farm allocation remains unknown.

findings.observed: The 102 completed boss rows produced 83 authoritative kills, 10 bot deaths, and 9 censored caps; by tier, T2 was 15/18 kills, T3 10/21, and T4 50/54.
findings.interpretation: Boss outcomes are available for the untreated breadth screen, with caps retained as censored and deaths retained as deaths.
findings.limitation: This is one reused seed and is not a win-probability or general balance claim.

findings.observed: For the nine reconstruction-r1 boss pairs, candidates killed 8/9 versus 3/9 controls; five control caps became candidate kills, while the remaining four pairs were two T2 kills retained and one T3 cap retained plus one T3 control kill retained.
findings.interpretation: The sealed matched screen shows an observed boss-side reconstruction signal in this seed, including candidate kills at T3/T4 rows that capped under their paired controls.
findings.limitation: The farming arm is unavailable, there is no independent repeat, and the package/range treatment is not a universal adoption proof.

findings.observed: No treatment is adopted, no alternative is selected, and no follow-on packet is generated by this run.
findings.interpretation: Return the boss-only matched observations and the farm harness mismatch to the command center for owner direction; preserve the raw run for any separately authorized repair or new packet.
findings.limitation: A repaired farm execution would be a new authorized run, not a continuation or retry of this sealed packet.
